top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific invention, the magic-wavelength lattice for neutral-atom optical clocks, with a measured and independently reproduced outcome near 1e-18 beyond the caesium definition, and a two-name allocation (Katori, Ye) that every supporter agrees on. P002 is conceptually deeper but its credit remains contested (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan) and its separation from the 2016 prize rests on citation wording; I rank it second ahead of no award because the science is mature.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp
